gloss: loss of contact; being out of touch

definitions.gloss: loss of contact; being out of touch; no communication
definitions.explanation: A state in which someone cannot be reached and no news or communication comes from them. Used when contact with a person has been completely lost.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}と{音信不通|おんしんふつう}になった。
examples.english: I lost contact with my friend.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}{以来|いらい}、{彼|かれ}とは{音信不通|おんしんふつう}だ。
examples.english: I've been out of touch with him since graduation.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}{音信不通|おんしんふつう}だった{兄|あに}から{突然|とつぜん}{連絡|れんらく}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: My brother, whom I hadn't heard from in ten years, suddenly got in touch.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}). Most commonly used with になる (to lose contact) or as a predicate with だ. Can describe both intentional disappearance and unintentional loss of contact.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音信不通|おんしんふつう}になる (to lose contact)
- {音信不通|おんしんふつう}のまま (remaining out of touch)
- {長年|ながねん}{音信不通|おんしんふつう}だった (had been out of touch for many years)
